description: Store one or more shop defaults for this installation. Each key replaces the value already there, and null clears one. Set one when the shop states a standing preference, not when a single job happens to differ from it. These are this installation's own preferences, kept in a file on the machine the server runs on rather than in Housecall Pro. Nothing here is read from Housecall Pro or sent to it. The file belongs to the installed server, so a shop running this on two computers sets its defaults on each. An arrival window has to be a width Housecall Pro accepts (0, 15, 20, 60, 120, 180 or 240 minutes), because one it does not accept would only surface later, as a failure on a booking.

arrival_window_minutes.description: How wide the arrival window quoted to the customer is by default. 0 means an exact time. Pass null to clear it.

job_duration_minutes.description: How long a job is scheduled for when nobody says otherwise. Pass null to clear it.

service_line_item_name.description: The name of the line item most jobs start from. Pass null to clear it.

name: hcp_set_defaults
